question: Is rainfall-associated recruitment of route-new calling species preferentially allocated to physical stops near lower-persistence surface water?
population: The frozen 4,236 matched NAAMP pairs, restricted at the response stage to pair x StopNumber rows with identical nonmissing SiteID in wet and dry runs.

sources.water: Microsoft Planetary Computer collection jrc-gsw; JRC Global Surface Water occurrence asset, 1984-2020.

context_definition.water_pixel: Occurrence value 1-100; 0 and nodata are not water pixels.
context_definition.primary_site_metric: Mean occurrence (%) among water pixels whose pixel centres fall within 200 m of the SiteID coordinate.
context_definition.pulse_index: 100 - mean occurrence, so larger values indicate more intermittently observed surface water.
context_definition.sensitivity_metric: 100 - 90th percentile occurrence among water pixels within 200 m; repeat primary metric at 500 m.
context_definition.no_water: Site is unclassified for a radius if no occurrence 1-100 pixel falls within the radius.

feasibility_gate.coverage: >=50% of pair-used SiteIDs with coordinates have >=1 water pixel within 200 m.
feasibility_gate.variation: SD of primary pulse_index across classified SiteIDs >=10 percentage points.
feasibility_gate.response_design: >=1000 matched pairs and >=300 routes have at least two classified physically stable stops with nonzero within-pair pulse-index variation.
feasibility_gate.pass: All three conditions must pass before any frog-response model is fitted.

response.unit: matched pair x physically stable stop
response.net_route_new: wet route-new gain count at the stop minus dry route-new loss count at the stop; summed over stops equals corner + taxonomic net incidence.
response.gain_only: wet route-new gain count at the stop, sensitivity only

model.design: Pair fixed-effects OLS by within-pair demeaning.
model.target: positive interaction: as rain contrast increases, route-new recruitment is preferentially allocated to lower-persistence water contexts.

interpretation_boundary: JRC water occurrence is long-term mapped context, not survey-night inundation.
The 1984-2020 occurrence product extends beyond the 2001-2015 NAAMP survey years and is used only as a habitat-persistence proxy.
A water pixel within 200 m is not proven call origin.
No physiological hydration mediator is identified.
No causal rainfall claim and no RC11 submission change are authorized.
